name: legal_plays
protocol_phrase: First call `legal_plays()` to get the exact legal candidate domino_ids; only evaluate domino_ids in that legal set.

name: play_brief
protocol_phrase: Call `play_brief(play=X)` once for each legal candidate play before committing.

name: belief_trajectory
protocol_phrase: Call `belief_trajectory()` if hidden ownership could distinguish otherwise close legal candidates.

name: board_snapshot
protocol_phrase: Call `board_snapshot()` if you need to reread the hand, trick, score, or history.
